content:
rachael: quick Q — when streaming chat/completions with func/tool events, some clients send delta chunks without a `role` field. Should server treat absent `role` as previous speaker or default to `assistant`? cc @joel @sasha

joel: short answer: runtime currently defaults to `assistant` for deltas if role missing, but that's an implementation choice not guaranteed by contract.

sasha: we should decide for contract. clients rely on default today. this affects audits + token attribution.

ben: examples? paste a streaming snippet we've seen:

```json
{ "type":"delta", "delta":{"content":"Calling weather API...","tool_call":{"name":"weather","args":"{city:\"sf\"}"}} }
{ "type":"delta", "delta":{"tool_call":{"name":"weather","args":"{temp_only:true}"}} }
{ "type":"final", "message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Got 62F"}} 
```

joel: exactly — no `role` on deltas. If consumers assume previous role they might misattribute if start-of-stream has role user.

rachael: my usecase: logs/metrics need to tag tokens to roles for cost breakdown. If default is `assistant` that's fine, but we need explicit contract.

sasha: proposal: contract rule = "If `role` is omitted on a delta, it MUST be interpreted as `assistant` UNLESS the first event in the stream specifies `role: user` and there's a `tool_call` start then events until `final` should keep original role" — that's messy.

ben: alternative simpler: require first message of stream to include `role`. if absent, return a 4xx (or set header to legacy-mode). but breaking.

joel: pragmatic plan: add header `x-rw-stream-role-default: assistant|inherit` that servers can set; clients can check on open. Backcompat: default server behavior = `assistant` (today). Add warning in release notes and 2-week deprecation.

rachael: SGTM. who owns PR to add header + spec text?

sasha: I'll draft PR updating convo schema + add tests in convo-proto. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-proto/pull/1032

ben: tiny followup: streaming tool_call shape — should `tool_call.args` be string or object? libs vary. current runtime accepts both but docs say string.

joel: canonical: allow either. contract: prefer `string` for streaming to avoid partial JSON reassembly issues; recommend `args_json` opaque chunks if needed. I'll add note.

rachael: action items: sasha to open PR with header + contract text; joel to add client-side check + test; ben to add note re tool args; i'll announce in release notes. thanks.

deployer-bot: canary deploy of convo-schema v2.4 started :white_check_mark:

sasha: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-proto/pull/1033 — includes header, examples, tests.

rachael: resolved for now, will follow up if any edgecases show up in canary. :thumbsup:
